purpose: Replace three type-only actor/player collision labels with behavior-based names while preserving their legacy aliases.

promotions.name: ActorCollision_ProcessType13Response

contract.dispatch: Receiving Type-0x13 actor-collision entry at ACTOR_COLLISION_HANDLER_TABLE + 0x4C
contract.source: Clears the colliding source and runs Actor_HandleType2DInteraction
contract.terminal: When the receiver phase is clear, adds its response weight, clears/reinitializes it from ACTOR_TEMPLATE_COLLISION_TYPE_84, and spawns a vertically offset child response
contract.staged: When the receiver phase is active, decrements it, installs movement 0x0012474C, and clears transient response fields

evidence: Exact 236-byte body ending at RTS 0x001AC21C and continuing through the Type-0x13 response branches
Direct calls to Actor_ClearOwnedResources, Actor_HandleType2DInteraction, Actor_ClearAndReleaseLinked, Actor_ClearOwnedResourcesFromA2, and Actor_InitializeFromTemplate
Direct Type-0x84 template loads at 0x001AC234 and 0x001AC262 with the -0x20 vertical response offset

promotions.name: ActorCollision_HandleWallTerminalResponse

contract.dispatch: Receiving Type-0x11 actor-collision entry at ACTOR_COLLISION_HANDLER_TABLE + 0x44
contract.wall: Allocates ACTOR_TEMPLATE_TYPE_8D_WALL_RESPONSE and copies the source position when a forward slot is available
contract.terminal: Adds the receiver response weight, clears/reinitializes it from ACTOR_TEMPLATE_COLLISION_TYPE_84, and arms SCENE_SCRIPT_COUNTDOWN=0x14 on the Type-0x11 branch
contract.cleanup: The non-Type-0x11 branch clears matching Type-0x8D/0x4D actor records and may spawn a Type-0x84 companion

evidence: Direct Type-0x8D wall-response template load at 0x001AC532
Direct Type-0x84 terminal-template loads at 0x001AC58E and 0x001AC5F6

promotions.name: PlayerCollision_HandleInteractionProximityResponse

contract.dispatch: Shared player-collision entry for runtime actor types 0x18 and 0x19
contract.interaction: Routes ungated contacts through Player_ProcessInteractionState and applies the Type-0x19 sound/lock branch
contract.proximity: Compares actor X against PLAYER_WORLD_X using PLAYER_FACING_BYTE and the actor-relative proximity condition
contract.response: Installs or reinitializes the Type-0x84 response actor, publishes interaction response state, and optionally queues event 0x23

evidence: Exact 306-byte body ending at the two-byte RTS at 0x001AEB78
Direct Type-0x84 template load at 0x001AEB2C and optional event-0x23 audio at 0x001AEB66

conclusion: The promoted names distinguish the Type-0x13 staged response, Type-0x11 wall/terminal response, and Type-0x18/0x19 player interaction/proximity response without discarding dispatch-type aliases.
